Name: Seasonal Young Wizard
Author: AlmostMidnight
Description:
Hello there, welcome to my mod! A portrait and sprite mod in the vanilla style for the wizard! Seasonal and SVE compatible. Honestly I was never happy with the younger wizard mods currently out there but there was always a different reason why. (For me, one portrait just wasn't vanilla enough, or was a little too vanilla, etc.) So I just made one of my own to suit my own preferences. :P

The sprites and portrait are in the style of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url] so make sure those mods are installed!

[size=4]If you don't use SVE, just replace the assets file in Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic.

If you DO use SVE, download both and replace the asset file in Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic AND Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE.
[b]MAKE SURE YOU USE THE RIGHT FOLDER FOR THE RIGHT MOD!!!

[/b][/size][color=#ff00ff]I'll try making a Content Patcher version eventually so you won't have to replace files but this might be awhile until I fix my other portrait mod. This is the way to do things for now though :)[/color]

Downloads.Description:
Replace the asset file in Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic with the asset file in this one.

See changelog for notes.

Replace the asset file in Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic For SVE with the asset file in this one.

Make sure you use the other file for the non SVE Seasonal Outfits mod.

See changelog for notes.
